articles.title: Stablecoin governance group behind OUSD sets out management fee, offers equity earning pool
articles.snippet: Governance group Open Standard will charge a 0.1 basis point management fee on payment volume, capped at at $0.01 per payment.

articles.title: Animoca Brands clears final hurdle for Abu Dhabi fund management
articles.snippet: The former mobile games company is building out its fund management business in Abu Dhabi as it targets institutional demand for stablecoins and tokenized assets.
